z-m-08-05.title: Dhererka harsan kadib isticmaalka 3.47 m ribbon 10 m ah
z-m-08-05.topic: Barbar dhigga hababka loo jaro tiro laba meelood jajab tobanle ah tiro dhan
z-m-08-05.goal: Barbar dhig dhowr hab oo isla dhibaato lagu xalliyo si aad u kala dooratid kuwa sax ah, u isticmaal qiyaas si aad u shaandheyso jawaabaha khaldan, oo sheeg habka ku habboon tirooyinkan gaarka ah, sabab ku jirta.
z-m-08-05.material:
Ribbon dhererkiisu yahay 10 m, 3.47 m ayaa la gooyay oo la isticmaalay. Shan saaxiib ayaa helay dhererka ribbon-ka harsan sidan.
Mina: Ka jar 3 10 si aad u hesho 7, kadibna ku dheji qaybta jajab tobanle 0.47 sida ay tahay, sidaas darteed 7.47 m.
Jiho: U qor 10 sida 10.00, saf dhibcaha jajab tobanle, oo toos u jar si aad u hesho 6.53 m.
Haneul: U beddel 3.47 3.5 oo jar si aad u hesho sax ahaan 6.5 m.
Raon: U arag 10 sida 1000/100 iyo 3.47 sida 347/100 si aad u hesho 653/100, taasoo ah 6.53 m.
Soyeon: Ka jar 3 10 si aad u sameyso 7, kadibna ka jar 0.47 oo dheeraad ah 7 si aad u hesho 6.53 m.

z-m-08-05.s.s1.r.a: Haddii aad qaybta jajab tobanle ku dhejiso sida ay tahay, 3 oo keliya ayaad ka jartay 3.47. Mar kale eeg waxa lagu sameeyay 0.47.

Mina ma jarin 0.47 laakiin wuu ku dhejiyay, sidaas darteed wuxuu helay 7.47, Haneul-na wuxuu beddelay 3.47 ilaa 3.5, sidaas darteed wuxuu helay 6.5, taasoo aan ahayn qiimaha saxda ah. Habka Haneul waxaa loo isticmaali karaa qiyaasidda.

z-m-08-08.title: Cabbirka qaybta midab leh ee shabakad 100-labajibaar ah
z-m-08-08.topic: Tirooyin laba meelood jajab tobanle ah oo lagu arkay shabakad 100-labajibaar ah

Markaas hal labajibaar waa 0.01.
